name: Big Small World
source:
It's 2008. A new school year and a new roof awaits Mubina, but despite the normalcy, some very strange occurrences start happening. Her parents seem to know but won't divulge anything about them. Then, a strange lady who resembles a late relative, shows up in a dream, challenges her in a game, then disappears. What in the world is going on? To make matters worse, some peers act shady, especially around Mubina and her neighbor. 

[From [url=https://mudmood-studio.itch.io/big-small-world]Itch.io[/url]]
